steps.title: Collect Nasopharyngeal Swabs
steps.instruction: Collect NP swabs by sampling the posterior nasopharynx through both nares using a sterilized swab. Insert the swab into a 5 mL sample tube containing 3 mL viral transport media (VTM) and break the handle at the pre-scored area.

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Master Mix
steps.instruction: In a biological safety cabinet, prepare the lysis master mix in a 100 mL Eppendorf reservoir (PN: 960051017) by adding components in the following order:

substeps.instruction: Thoroughly vortex Mag-Bind Particles CNR until no clumps appear.
Add Isopropanol: 31.5 mL (280 µL/extraction)
Add TNA Lysis Buffer: 27.0 mL (240 µL/extraction)
Add Proteinase K Solution: 1.125 mL (10 µL/extraction)
Add Mag-Bind Particles CNR: 1.125 mL (10 µL/extraction)
Add Carrier RNA: 0.9 mL (8 µL/extraction)
Verify total volume is 61.65 mL (548 µL/extraction)

steps.title: Dispense Lysis Master Mix into SEP
steps.instruction: Use the epMotion 5075 to transfer the Lysis Master Mix into a KingFisher deep-well 96-well plate (PN: 95040450), labeled 'SEP' (Sample Extraction Plate).

substeps.instruction: Open epBlue software (v40.7) and run program: Application_2b_Lysis_Plates_1plate_210205_083127.export7
Place 1000 µL epTIPs in position A2.
Place reservoir rack in position B2 with the 100 mL lysis MM reservoir in the first slot.
Place the SEP plate in position C2.
Set volume to 'Use required minimum volumes', uncheck 'Check labware placement' and 'Check tube lid removed'.
Enter 96 for the number of samples and run the program.
Seal the SEP with a Bio-Rad Microseal 'B' and store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Sample Storage Plate (SSP)
steps.instruction: Prepare a KingFisher deep-well 96-well plate (PN: 95040450) labeled 'SSP' (Sample Storage Plate) in a biosafety cabinet.

substeps.instruction: Cover columns 12 through 2 with lab tape, overlapping each strip, leaving only column 1 open.
Add 700 µL VTM into Negative Control (well A1) and Positive Control (well H1) using a P1000 pipette, changing tips between wells.
Briefly vortex 94 NP swab sample tubes for 3-5 seconds.
Transfer 700 µL from each sample tube to the SSP wells using a P1000 with extended tips, changing tips between samples.
Fill the plate vertically (column by column), moving the tape to expose one column at a time, skipping wells A1 and H1.

steps.title: Transfer Samples from SSP to SEP
steps.instruction: Transfer samples from the SSP to the SEP in a biosafety cabinet.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the SEP at 4400 x g, 4 °C for 10 seconds.
Cover SEP columns 1 through 11 with lab tape, leaving only column 12 open.
Using a P300 multichannel pipette, transfer 200 µL from each SSP well into the corresponding SEP well.
Pipette up and down once to mix; avoid touching the tape.
Process one column at a time, moving the tape to the left as you proceed.
Seal both plates with 96-well sealing mats (PN: AB0566).
Spray both plates generously with 70% EtOH on all sides and wipe excess with a paper towel.
Apply two aluminum seals perpendicular to the sealing mat on the SEP.
Place used 15 mL sample tubes in a resealable bag, spray the bag with 70% EtOH, and remove from the cabinet.

steps.title: Prepare MS2 Phage Control
steps.instruction: Prepare 1:160 diluted MS2 phage aliquots if necessary.

substeps.instruction: Combine 39.750 mL nuclease-free water and 250 µL MS2 phage control (PN: 100092698) in a 50 mL conical tube to make 40 mL solution.
Aliquot 1.2 mL of the solution into sterile 2.0 mL microcentrifuge tubes labeled 'MS2'.
Store aliquots at -20 °C.

steps.title: Add MS2 Phage to SEP
steps.instruction: Use the epMotion 5075 to add the MS2 phage control to the SEP.

substeps.instruction: Thaw one 1.2 mL aliquot of 1:160 diluted MS2 phage.
Load program: Application_4_MS2_additiontolysisplate.export7
Place 10 µL epTIPs in position A2.
Place a metal reservoir rack in position B5; place a 10 mL reservoir labeled 'MS2' in the first slot.
Transfer 1200 µL of thawed MS2 phage into the 'MS2' reservoir using a P1000 with filter tips.
Load the SEP (seal removed) into position B4.
Set volume to 'Use minimum required volumes', uncheck 'Check labware placement' and 'Check tube lid removed'.
Enter '1200 µL' when prompted for volume and run the program.
Seal SEP with a temporary seal and centrifuge at 4400 x g, 4 °C for 10 seconds.

steps.title: Prepare Wash and Elution Plates
steps.instruction: Prepare the VHB, SPR, and RNA Elution Plate (REP) using the epMotion 5075.

substeps.instruction: Prepare three 100 mL reservoirs: 'VHB' (40 mL VHB wash buffer), 'SPR' (100 mL SPR wash buffer), and 'H2O' (100 mL nuclease-free water).
Load program: Application_5a_wash_aliquoting_1plate_210205_183714.export7
Place 1000 µL epTIPs in position A2.
Place reservoir rack in position B3 with reservoirs in order: VHB (Pos 1), SPR (Pos 2), H2O (Pos 3).
Place one deep-well plate 'VHB' in C1, two deep-well plates 'SPR' in C2 and C3, and one standard 96-well plate 'REP' in C4.
Set volume to 'Use minimum required volumes', uncheck 'Check labware placement' and 'Check tube lid removed'.
Enter '96' for number of samples and run the program.
The program dispenses 400 µL VHB into the VHB plate, 500 µL SPR into both SPR plates, and 75 µL nuclease-free water into the REP plate.
Seal plates with aluminum foil or proceed to extraction.

steps.title: Automated RNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract RNA using the KingFisher Flex benchtop automated instrument.

substeps.instruction: Load plates as prompted by the instrument in this order: Tip Comb Plate (with KingFisher 96 Tip Comb for DW Magnets), REP, SPR1, SPR2, VHB, and SEP.
Once finished, remove the REP (containing 75 µL purified RNA per well) and seal with AlumaSeal using a plate roller.
Remove and discard the SEP, VHB, and SPR plates after pouring liquid into chemical waste.

steps.title: Compress RNA into 384-well Plate
steps.instruction: Compress 1-4 REPs into one 384-well RNA Working Plate (RWP) using the epMotion 5075.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge REPs at 1000 x g, 4 °C for 1 minute.
Load program: Application_4x96_1x384_bycolumn_compression_210120_144251.export7
Place 50 µL pipette tip boxes in positions A2-A5 (one per REP).
Place REPs in positions B2-B5 (starting with B2).
Place a clean Bio-Rad Hard-Shell 384-well barcoded PCR plate (HSP3901) in position C4.
Remove REP seals and tip box covers.
Set volume to 'Use minimum required volumes', uncheck 'Check labware placement' and 'Check tube lid removed'.
Enter '96' for the first plate, and '96' or '0' for subsequent plates depending on the number of REPs being processed.
Run the program to transfer 20 µL of each sample to the RWP.
Store RWP at -80 °C.
